categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in semiconductor packaging materials, specifically developing, manufacturing, and selling epoxy molding compounds (EMC) and electronic adhesives. These materials are used in semiconductor packaging and board-level assembly applications. The company serves both traditional packaging (DIP, TO, SOT, SOP) and advanced packaging (QFN/BGA, SiP, FC, FOWLP/FOPLP) segments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies center on formulation technology and production process technology for epoxy molding compounds and electronic adhesives. Key technical capabilities include stress control, warpage control, thermal conductivity enhancement, moisture resistance, reliability assurance, and compatibility with various substrate materials. The company employs mixing, molding, and specialized processing techniques to produce both solid granular and liquid adhesive products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are semiconductor packaging and testing companies including long-term partners such as Changjiang Electronics Technology, Tongfu Microelectronics, Huatian Technology, Galaxy Microelectronics, and Yangjie Electronics. End markets include consumer electronics, photovoltaic, automotive electronics, industrial applications, and Internet of Things. The company primarily serves domestic Chinese markets with minimal export sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Lianyungang Economic and Technological Development Zone. Sales are concentrated in East China, Southwest, and South China regions, with minimal international presence. The company has established a sales network covering major semiconductor packaging hubs in China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the semiconductor supply chain, specifically in the materials supply segment for semiconductor packaging. It provides critical materials to downstream semiconductor packaging and testing companies, which in turn serve integrated circuit manufacturers and end-product manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing advanced packaging material development, particularly for QFN, BGA, SiP, FC, and FOWLP/FOPLP applications. R&D focuses on solving key technical challenges including low-stress formulations, high thermal conductivity, warpage control, and reliability enhancement. The company emphasizes product localization and import substitution, with significant investment in talent acquisition and collaborative research with domestic universities.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of epoxy molding compounds and electronic adhesives to semiconductor packaging companies, with a smaller portion from distributor channels. Revenue is based on product sales with pricing determined through customer negotiations and market conditions. The company operates on a make-to-order and demand-forecast combined production model.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors are primarily foreign companies including international leaders in epoxy molding compounds. Domestically, the company is positioned as a leading indigenous supplier. In traditional packaging segments (TO, DIP), domestic suppliers including the company have gained market dominance. In high-performance and advanced packaging segments, foreign companies maintain dominant market positions. The company holds approximately 5% or less market share and is in an acceleration phase of import substitution.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized semiconductor materials manufacturer with 2023 revenue of 282.9 million yuan, representing a 6.7% decline from 2022 due to industry cyclicality. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 31.6 million yuan, down 23.26% year-over-year. Total assets reached 1.23 billion yuan as of end-2023, up 143.32% from prior year, primarily due to IPO proceeds. The company achieved profitability and is growing from a relatively small base.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through rapid customer service response, comprehensive product portfolio covering both traditional and advanced packaging, strong R&D capabilities with experienced technical team, established quality control systems, and long-term stable relationships with major customers. Key advantages include domestic supply chain security, customization capabilities, technical expertise in solving customer-specific challenges, and competitive pricing relative to foreign alternatives.
